title: Mount, permissions and storage dependencies
summary: Writable-layer, bind mount and volume behavior differ. A workload may fail from a missing mount, UID mismatch, read-only path, disk/inode exhaustion or host storage latency while Engine remains reachable.
checks: Correlate separately approved filesystem capacity/inode evidence and mount intent.
Verify workload UID and data-path contracts with an operator; compare application read/oracle evidence.
limitations: No container filesystem, raw logs, environment or mounted data is read by this module.
